title: DEEP QUOTA
what_i_found: Depth is the difficulty curve and the price list at the same time, so the map needs no gates and no locks: the fish that pay are simply further from air. The recipe's exterior render rig is not switched off underwater, it is driven with water numbers, so aerial perspective stops being haze and becomes absorption and crossing the surface is a lerp between two rows of one table rather than a cut. And the boat is the only safe place in the game and also the shallowest, which is exactly where the orca hunts.
